effects.printed_clause: This Ritual Monster can be Ritual Summoned with any Nephthys Ritual Spell.
effects.lua_implementation: EnableReviveLimit and Nephthys set identity allow standard Nephthys Ritual Spell filters to select it; no bespoke procedure belongs on the Ritual Monster.

official_references.matched_structure: Shinobaroness Shade Peacock is a Ritual Spirit whose summon compatibility is driven by Ritual Spell filtering and card data.

effects.printed_clause: If Special Summoned: reveal a Nephthys monster in Deck; destroy it.
effects.lua_implementation: The delayed trigger’s pre-semicolon cost selects, confirms and effect-relates one destructable set monster in Deck; operation destroys it to GY.

official_references.matched_structure: Ojamassimilation demonstrates confirm/reveal selection from Deck/Extra; official Nephthys scripts destroy cards in Deck/hand by effect.
Official Nephthys structures select and destroy Nephthys cards from the hand/Deck.

effects.printed_clause: Then apply that destroyed card’s Standby Phase-activated effect.
effects.lua_implementation: After the selected Deck monster is destroyed, CheckActivateEffect(true,true,true) obtains an effect and directly invokes its target and operation outside the original Standby Phase event.

official_references.matched_structure: Darklord Eveningstar uses CheckActivateEffect to apply another card’s activation effect.
Conductor of Nephthys provides official Nephthys delayed-effect structures.

effects.issue: Unresolved engine/design gap: Omega has no exact official mechanism for identifying and immediately applying an arbitrary monster's specific Standby Phase trigger; cards with multiple effects remain ambiguous.

effects.printed_clause: Shuffle this card from hand into Deck; add a Nephthys Spell/Trap from Deck or GY.
effects.lua_implementation: Hand ignition sends handler to shuffled Deck as cost and searches a Necrovalley-legal set S/T from Deck/GY.

official_references.matched_structure: Self-recovery from the GY conditioned on a GY banish cost; the CCG effect instead returns itself to the Deck.

effects.printed_clause: Each effect is once per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Ash Blossom & Joyous Spring supplies named HOPT structure.
